ownership.native_values: copied values and opaque provider-owned IDs; never cross-instance pointers/function-pointers
ownership.publication: actual paired public surface/private basis+head settlement accepted synchronously before browser receipt release
ownership.unknown: retained exact request/raw outcome; process terminal; no cleanup, retry, synthetic leave/result or authority promotion

qualification: definitions/checksums and mock fixtures establish no actual engine capability; exact installed handlers, retained build/source/proof and actual runtime gates are required

retirement.command9: latest checked provider-owned retained one-slot material and full original target only; no App-guessed held keys or IME; all full Host TURN; current-document equality may be bypassed only for command9 after mandatory inert admission proves that exact historical slot; actual cleanup/readback concerns only the original native authority, never a replacement DOM
retirement.material: provider-issued exact token/mapping/input_context/composition, checked against original full target
retirement.navigation: native8 may return original authority retired in its checked result; after native5/timer/lifecycle navigation, historical9 may return actual provider-owned already-retired original-authority attestation only after natural-unwind revalidation; metadata invalidation, STALE and absent UI are not retirement proof
retirement.new_token: requires exact previous material in the same checked NativeResult.retired, or no previous obligation
retirement.query4: cannot silently replace unretired token; typed unavailable blocks input
retirement.same_token: fresh checked readback of same native context may refresh exact material metadata

sequence_policy.kernel_async_ticket: separate owner-issued ticket correlated before accepting each query/native completion; ordinary wire request_sequence is provider nonce
sequence_policy.replay: commands8/9 and query4 are at-most-once; consumed sequences never enter backend again
